scientific_intent.scientific_task: Spatially interpolate sample scalar values using adaptive inverse-distance weighting
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Fuzzy nearest-neighbor statistic selects distance-decay exponent; normalized positive distance weights accumulate all sample values for each target
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Scattered planar sample points and query points; no mesh or PDE discretization
invariants: Positive finite weights produce output in convex hull of sample scalar range
Coordinates must avoid coincident sample-query singularities for this unregularized kernel
accuracy_requirements: Native EPS1; named finite-output study atol1e-3 rtol0
Preserve source piecewise fuzzy-alpha constants and Float32 arithmetic
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Inverse powers amplify near-coincident point contributions; division and pow approximate rounding can affect weighted normalized sum
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: O(data_points * interpolation_points), matched1024x1024 fixture; no full-scale scaling claim
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Geospatial scattered-data surface interpolation; source credits China University of Geosciences and GPU adaptive-IDW publications
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No particular environmental field or realworld dataset is encoded in benchmark fixture
